outlook.statement: The Board of Directors and the Management of the Company are working on various strategies to scale up the operations of the Company.

NBFC sector projected to grow at CAGR of 18.5% between 2021 and 2026; NBFC AUM estimated to have grown 16-18% in FY 2023-24 and 14-17% in FY 2024-25, crossing INR 32 trillion by March 2025; industry forecasts projecting 14% compounded growth over ensuing two years
India on track to become USD 5 trillion economy by FY 2027, potential to scale to USD 7 trillion by 2030; GDP projected to grow ~6.5% in 2024
Company committed to expanding presence across underserved markets, strengthening asset quality, delivering responsible and scalable credit solutions aligned with long-term strategic goals
